title: How Jacky Chou monetizes SEO: partnerships, rank and rent, lean teams, personal branding
summary: Jacky explains why he prefers revenue-share partnerships on big authority sites over client retainers and niche sites. He covers rank-and-rent monetization, running paid ads to drive branded search, delegating with an EA, and keeping a team lean. He also argues links matter more than content.

principles.text: Partner with established sites: carve out a subdirectory on their domain and run an affiliate site inside it for a revenue share.
principles.quote: you approach a company where their core product is not display ads or affiliate Revenue so for example you go up to some local newspaper and say Hey yo uh morning son let me let me carve out a subdirectory on your site

principles.text: Revenue-share partnerships align incentives and scale better than retainers, where the math doesn't work.
principles.quote: I think everyone's aligned right because you make more money if they make more money and with retainers it's not so yeah everyone's interests aren't so aligned and also the math doesn't work out for retainers

principles.text: Rank the same keywords across multiple partners, then charge brands for top slots (rank and rent); it can out-earn affiliate.
principles.quote: we make more in rank and rents so like client uh companies paying us to be top slot for like best protein powder then Affiliates

principles.text: Share what you do publicly; it generates inbound deals so you don't have to pitch.
principles.quote: I think I'm able to make this much money because I share and then if you talk more about it the more you get

principles.text: Personal branding pays through deal flow, and most people under-monetize; put an offer at the end of every post.
principles.quote: everyone should have an offer at the end of the at the end of a tweet you know

principles.text: Links matter more than content. Don't believe 'content is king'; build links if you have no partnership.
principles.quote: people who say links don't matter are also idiots like links are everything everything uh so if you don't have a partnership then you need to start building links
